findings.title: QUATERNION._transfer(address,address,uint256) uses timestamp for comparisons
findings.description:
Logic depends on block.timestamp, which miners can nudge by a few seconds (informational). Slither: QUATERNION._transfer(address,address,uint256) (QUATERNION.sol#273-311) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- require(bool,string)(_buyInfo[from] == 0 || _buyInfo[from].add(_timeLimitFromLastBuy) < now,ERC20: Tx not allowed yet.) (QUATERNION.sol#285)

incident.name: QTNToken
incident.summary: QTNToken (2023-01-18), documented in the DeFiHackLabs repository: business logic flaw. Reported loss: ~2ETH.
